purpose: Verified role and access contract separating citizen input, evidence handling, legal analysis, review, publication and system administration.
core_principle: NO ROLE MAY SILENTLY CROSS A MATERIAL EVIDENCE, LEGAL, REVIEW OR PUBLICATION BOUNDARY.
separation_of_duties: citizen input is not official evidence
evidence retrieval is not legal adjudication
legal analysis is not property-record creation
review is not silent source alteration
administration is not substantive case rewriting
least_privilege_rule: Access should be limited to information and actions necessary for the assigned function.
provenance_rule: Material changes retain their source, actor/system identity and reason.
audit_rule: Access and material changes remain traceable in the investigation history.
public_boundary: Public presentation exposes only information approved for publication and does not expose restricted case data by default.
verification_boundary: The access layer controls permissions and responsibilities; it does not itself establish legal rights, ownership or other substantive conclusions.
